title: Rabbi Betzalel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In the work cited as דור רבה, beginning of chapter 1, Rabbi asked Rabbi Betzalel; Hyman gives as the correct reading the citation in the old Midrash Shmuel, chapter 28: “Rabbi Shaul said to Rabbi Betzalel.”

notes.text: The supplied דור רבה has not been identified. Derekh Eretz Rabbah is a possible expansion, but neither that proposed citation nor the old Midrash Shmuel 28 occurrence has been verified here. No edition-wide absence is asserted.

Ruth Rabbah 1:2 directly records Rabbi asking Rabbi Betzalel about Hosea 2:7. Betzalel answers that people come to despise Torah when its own teachers treat it with contempt. Hyman’s print appears to read בדור רבה. The Ruth Rabbah passage provides the matching dialogue. The older Midrash Shmuel edition cited by Hyman as reading “Rabbi Shaul said” remains unidentified.
